ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_010.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_010.ebm:4.original: Ah, no need to be scared. We just need to get our hands on those exam conditions!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_010.ebm:4.translation: Ах, не бойся. Нам просто нужно заполучить условия экзамена!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_010.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_010.ebm:6.original: Alrighty then. I guess S Rank was always going to be demanding.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_010.ebm:6.translation: Ну что ж. Ранг S, похоже, всегда был требовательным.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_010.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_010.ebm:7.original: Of course. But we can do it. It's us, Sis! We've got this!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_010.ebm:7.translation: Конечно. Но мы справимся. Мы же, сестрёнка! У нас получится!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_010.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_010.ebm:8.original: Hahaha, you're right. There's nothing we can't do! Let's do it!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_010.ebm:8.translation: Ха-ха-ха, ты права. Нет ничего невозможного! Давай!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:2.original: This is quite a party! What's up?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:3.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:3.original: We heard from Sophie and Firis that you've decided on a goal for your alchemy.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:3.translation: Мы слышали от Софи и Фирис, что вы определились с целью своей алхимии.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:4.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:4.original: Why didn't you come and tell me, then? Explain yourselves!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:4.translation: Почему же вы тогда не пришли и не сказали мне? Объяснитесь!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:5.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:5.original: Hahaha, sorry girls! We overheard you talking when we were inside the Starlight Plain.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:5.translation: Ха-ха-ха, простите, девочки! Мы подслушали ваш разговор, когда были на Звёздной равнине.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:6.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:6.original: Sorry from me too! We didn't mean to eavesdrop but, you know, I guess we did!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:6.translation: И от меня тоже простите! Мы не хотели подслушивать, но… получается, подслушали!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:7.original: Hahaha, that's okay. We weren't hiding it or anything. We were going to come and see you.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:7.translation: Ха-ха-ха, ничего. Мы не скрывали. Как раз собирались к вам зайти.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:8.original: So, the new goal for our alchemy, our new dream, is...
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:8.translation: Итак, новая цель нашей алхимии, наша новая мечта...

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:9.speaker: Together
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:9.original: To become alchemists who can help everyone!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:9.translation: Стать алхимиками, которые смогут помочь каждому!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:10.speaker: System
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:10.original: To become alchemists who can help everyone!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:10.translation: Стать алхимиками, которые смогут помочь каждому!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:11.original: So many people have helped us, and so we want to repay them by using our alchemy.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:11.translation: Нам помогло столько людей — и мы хотим отплатить им своей алхимией.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:12.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:12.original: I don't know if it's much of anything, but that's our goal. What do you think?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:12.translation: Не знаю, много ли это значит… но такова наша цель. Как думаете?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:13.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:13.original: I think it's wonderful. A lovely goal, perfectly suited to both of you.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:13.translation: Думаю, это чудесно. Прекрасная цель — как раз для вас обеих.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:14.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:14.original: Me too. You've decided it for yourselves, and so as your teacher... you have my support.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:14.translation: И я тоже. Вы сами это решили — и как ваша учительница… вы можете на меня рассчитывать.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:15.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:15.original: Do your very best, understand? Give up halfway through and you'll have me to deal with!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:15.translation: Старайтесь изо всех сил, понятно? Сдадитесь на полпути — будете иметь дело со мной!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:16.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:16.original: What happened to how happy you were when you found out about this, Ilmeria? You were smiling ear to ear!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:16.translation: А куда делась твоя радость, Ильмерия? Ты же улыбалась до ушей, когда узнала!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:17.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:17.original: Hey, cut it out, Firis! You don't need to bring that up here!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:17.translation: Эй, хватит, Фирис! Не надо это сейчас поднимать!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:18.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:18.original: Hahaha! Anyway, all of us here, including me, support your dream.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:18.translation: Ха-ха-ха! В любом случае, мы все здесь — и я тоже — поддерживаем вашу мечту.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:19.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:19.original: I don't think it will be an easy thing to achieve, but all the best, Lydie and Sue!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:19.translation: Добиться этого будет нелегко, но удачи вам, Лиди и Сью!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:20.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:20.original: Thank you! We'll do it, don't worry!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:21.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:21.original: Hehe! That's our goal, then! To become alchemists who can help everyone! Yay!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:21.translation: Хе-хе! Значит, вот наша цель! Стать алхимиками, которые помогут каждому! Ура!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:24.original: This is quite the party! What's up?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:42.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:42.original: Thank you! We'll do it, don't worry!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:43.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:43.original: Hehe! That's our goal, then! To become alchemists who can help everyone! Yay!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_020.ebm:43.translation: Хе-хе! Значит, вот наша цель! Стать алхимиками, которые помогут каждому! Ура!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:0.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:0.original: Hah. So the day has come when you two take on the S Rank? I can't believe it.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:0.translation: Ха. Итак, настал день, когда вы двое берётесь за ранг S? Не верится.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:1.original: Hahaha, we can't lag behind you forever. What rank are you now, anyway?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:1.translation: Ха-ха-ха, мы не можем вечно отставать от тебя. А какой у тебя сейчас ранг?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:2.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:2.original: I'm A Rank too, thank you very much. Drop your guard and I'll be S Rank before you!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:2.translation: Я тоже A-ранга, большое спасибо. Ослабьте бдительность — и я стану S раньше вас!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:3.original: I see. A powerful opponent appears. We'd better be careful not to lose to you!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:3.translation: Понятно. Появился серьёзный соперник. Нам лучше не проиграть тебе!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:4.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:4.original: That's right. We'll take you on fair and square, Lucia!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:4.translation: Верно. Мы примем тебя честно, Люсия!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:8.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:8.original: I thought Sue was going to come out with her normal "You'll never make S Rank, Lucia!"
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:8.translation: Я думала, Сью как обычно скажет: «Ты никогда не добьёшься ранга S, Люсия!»

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:9.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:9.original: Lydie, too. She never would have faced me head on like that before.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:9.translation: И Лиди тоже. Раньше она бы так в лоб со мной не столкнулась.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:10.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:10.original: They've both grown up so much!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:11.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:11.original: Bah, this isn't the time to be congratulating them! They are my rivals!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:11.translation: Ба, не время их поздравлять! Они мои соперницы!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:12.speaker: Lucia
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:12.original: I need to keep training myself, so I can continue to put up a fight!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_030.ebm:12.translation: Мне нужно продолжать тренироваться, чтобы и дальше с ними тягаться!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:0.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:0.original: Hello... wah! Look at all these customers!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:1.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:1.original: Ah, perfect timing! Sorry, but can you give me a hand?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:1.translation: Ах, как раз вовремя! Простите, не поможете?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:2.original: Ah, of course! We'll dive right in!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:3.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:3.original: Thanks so much. I've got so much on my plate already, and then that bunch showed up!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:3.translation: Огромное спасибо. У меня и так дел по горло — и тут ещё эта толпа!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:4.original: Your atelier really is popular, isn't it?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:4.translation: Твоё ателье и правда популярно, да?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:5.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:5.original: Haha, what are you talking about? Your atelier is the talk of the town!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:5.translation: Ха-ха, о чём ты? О вашем ателье говорит весь город!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:6.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:6.original: You're even aiming for S Rank, aren't you? Soon enough you'll just overtake me.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:6.translation: Вы даже целитесь в ранг S, правда? Очень скоро обгоните меня.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:7.original: Ah, come on! You could become S Rank whenever you wanted, surely?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:7.translation: Ах, ну же! Ты ведь можешь стать S, когда захочешь?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:8.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:8.original: It's not that easy. It takes more than skill with alchemy to raise your rank.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:8.translation: Не так всё просто. Чтобы поднять ранг, одного мастерства в алхимии мало.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:9.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:9.original: I've had so much work recently, too, I haven't had time to consider my rank at all!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:9.translation: Да и работы в последнее время столько, что о ранге совсем не думала!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:10.original: Hahaha, it must be tough being so busy!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:10.translation: Ха-ха-ха, наверное, тяжело быть такой занятой!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:11.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:11.original: So please, girls, go right ahead and surpass me!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:11.translation: Так что, девочки, вперёд — превзойдите меня!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:12.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:12.original: It's your dream to become the greatest in the kingdom, right? Well, you're almost there!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_040.ebm:12.translation: Ваша мечта — стать величайшими в королевстве, верно? Ну вот — вы почти у цели!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:1.original: W-What's up? Why are you staring like that?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:2.original: I know! You've finally realized how cute we are!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:2.translation: Знаю! Ты наконец поняла, какие мы милые!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:3.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:3.original: No, that's not it. Actually, I was thinking how mature you look. How grown up.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:3.translation: Нет, не то. Вообще-то я думала, какие вы повзрослевшие. Совсем взрослые.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:4.original: Uwah, you just came out and said it! You don't need to be so direct.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:4.translation: Ува, ты так прямо и сказала! Не обязательно быть настолько прямой.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:5.original: Hahaha! Mireille, you really think we've changed that much?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:5.translation: Ха-ха-ха! Мирей, ты правда думаешь, что мы так сильно изменились?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:6.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:6.original: Yes, totally. What did you have going for yourselves when you first showed up here?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:6.translation: Да, полностью. Что у вас было за душой, когда вы впервые явились сюда?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:7.original: Uwah! You aren't holding back today, are you!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:7.translation: Ува! Ты сегодня совсем не сдерживаешься!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:8.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:8.original: You think? Yet now, those two useless twins own one of the best ateliers in the kingdom.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:8.translation: Думаете? А теперь эти две бесполезные близняшки владеют одним из лучших ателье королевства.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:9.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:9.original: The look in your eyes, your alchemy skills, and your mindset overall have completely changed.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:9.translation: Взгляд, навыки алхимии и весь ваш настрой — всё совершенно изменилось.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:10.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:10.original: Heheh, you do really think so? It does make me happy to hear you say that.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:10.translation: Хе-хе, ты правда так думаешь? Мне очень приятно это слышать.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:11.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:11.original: Keep it up, then! I want to see you be the first to reach the glory of S Rank!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:11.translation: Тогда так и держите! Хочу видеть, как вы первыми достигнете славы ранга S!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:12.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:12.original: I support you all the way, Lydie, Sue!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:12.translation: Я полностью вас поддерживаю, Лиди, Сью!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:13.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:13.original: No problem! We'll be known far and wide for having the cutest possible atelier in the kingdom!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:13.translation: Без проблем! Мы прославимся на весь мир самым милым ателье королевства!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:14.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:14.original: Ah, well... If that's what you want?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_050.ebm:14.translation: Ах, ну… Если вам того хочется?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:0.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:0.original: Ah, hello girls. Are you an S Rank Atelier yet?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:0.translation: Ах, здравствуйте, девочки. Вы уже ателье ранга S?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:1.original: No, not yet. We're still working on it.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:1.translation: Нет, ещё нет. Мы всё ещё над этим работаем.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:2.original: What about you, then, Alt? What rank are you?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:2.translation: А ты, Альт? Какой у тебя ранг?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:3.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:3.original: I got bored of the whole thing, to be honest.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:3.translation: Если честно, мне всё это надоело.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:4.original: Bored?! Bored of the Ranking System?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:5.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:5.original: Yeah. I did reach B Rank.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:5.translation: Ага. Я дошёл до ранга B.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:6.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:6.original: But I don't really need any money, and I can already do all the alchemy I like.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:6.translation: Но деньги мне особо не нужны, а алхимией я уже могу заниматься как хочу.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:7.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:7.original: So I'm not bothered about raising my rank any higher. That's all.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:7.translation: Так что повышать ранг дальше мне незачем. Вот и всё.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:8.original: Wow. So decisive. That's just like you, Alt.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:8.translation: Ого. Так решительно. Это очень на тебя похоже, Альт.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:9.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:9.original: You think so? Let's just leave it at that, anyway.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:9.translation: Думаешь? В любом случае, оставим это.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:10.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:10.original: Your goal is to raise your Atelier Rank and become the greatest in the kingdom, though, right?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:10.translation: А ваша цель — поднять ранг ателье и стать величайшими в королевстве, верно?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:11.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:11.original: So you need to push on through! I'm sure it will work out, so long as you don't give up.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:11.translation: Значит, нужно идти дальше! Уверен — получится, лишь бы не сдавались.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:12.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:12.original: That's the plan! Thanks for the advice, Alt!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_060.ebm:12.translation: Так и сделаем! Спасибо за совет, Альт!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:0.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:0.original: Ah, Lydie, Sue! You're coming close to S Rank now!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:0.translation: Ах, Лиди, Сью! Вы уже близко к рангу S!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:1.original: That's right! Although I'm not sure we can even take the exam yet.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:1.translation: Верно! Хотя не уверена, что мы уже можем сдать экзамен.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:2.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:2.original: Hahaha, you'll be fine. You'll do it, no problem. Just keep up the good work!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:2.translation: Ха-ха-ха, у вас всё получится. Справитесь без проблем. Просто продолжайте в том же духе!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:3.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:3.original: This Atelier Rank stuff is harder than I expected. I can't seem to get past B Rank.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:3.translation: Эта система рангов ателье сложнее, чем я думала. Кажется, я застряла на B.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:5.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:5.original: It's because you have to raise the reputation of your atelier too.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:5.translation: Потому что нужно ещё и поднимать репутацию ателье.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:6.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:6.original: Which means you have to actually take some work. Firis isn't very good at that!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:6.translation: А значит — реально браться за заказы. Фирис в этом не очень сильна!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:7.original: I'm always out and about, so I often miss chances to work.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:7.translation: Я всегда в разъездах, так что часто упускаю шансы поработать.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:8.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:8.original: Ah, I see. I guess that makes sense.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:9.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:9.original: Miss Sophie isn't any better! She doesn't like the Ranking System either, so she won't help me.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:9.translation: Мисс Софи не лучше! Ей тоже не нравится Система рангов, так что она мне не помогает.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:10.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:10.original: Hahaha. I don't like those kind of restrictions. I'm not good with them.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:10.translation: Ха-ха-ха. Мне не нравятся такие ограничения. Я с ними не лажу.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:11.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:11.original: Anyway, the two of you seem to be doing well increasing your reputation.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:11.translation: В любом случае, вы двое, похоже, отлично поднимаете репутацию.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:12.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:12.original: You've almost reached the greatest atelier in the kingdom! We're supporting you all the way!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_070.ebm:12.translation: Вы почти стали величайшим ателье королевства! Мы вас во всём поддерживаем!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_080.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_080.ebm:0.original: Gulp! You haven't got this wrong?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_080.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_080.ebm:1.original: No, I haven't. I've checked it multiple times. I'm sure!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_080.ebm:1.translation: Нет. Я проверяла много раз. Уверена!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_080.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_080.ebm:2.original: This means we can finally take the S Rank exam! We've made it, Lydie!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_080.ebm:2.translation: Значит, мы наконец можем сдать экзамен на ранг S! Мы добились этого, Лиди!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_080.ebm:3.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_080.ebm:3.original: Phew. It took long enough! One difficult task after another.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_080.ebm:3.translation: Уф. Долго же это заняло! Одна трудная задача за другой.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_080.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_080.ebm:4.original: Yeah, you said it. But each difficulty has only made us grow stronger!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_080.ebm:4.translation: Ага, вот именно. Но каждая трудность только делала нас сильнее!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_080.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_080.ebm:5.original: Let's take all that momentum and pass the S Rank exam!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_080.ebm:5.translation: Давай возьмём этот задор и сдадим экзамен на ранг S!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_090.ebm:1.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_090.ebm:1.original: You've got the rep and you've got the skills. I'm ready to let you take the S Rank exam.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_090.ebm:1.translation: Репутация есть, навыки есть. Я готова допустить вас к экзамену на ранг S.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_090.ebm:2.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_090.ebm:2.original: Are you ready for the challenge of becoming the greatest atelier in the kingdom?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_090.ebm:2.translation: Готовы принять вызов и стать величайшим ателье королевства?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_090.ebm:3.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_090.ebm:3.original: Okay, that's no problem. Just let me know when you're ready.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_090.ebm:3.translation: Хорошо, без проблем. Просто дайте знать, когда будете готовы.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:0.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:0.original: Very well. This is the last time we'll be going through this together, isn't it!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:0.translation: Очень хорошо. Это в последний раз мы проходим через это вместе, да!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:1.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:1.original: Ah, sorry, no time to get emotional. This is just work! I have to see it through.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:1.translation: Ах, простите — некогда рассиропливаться. Это просто работа! Нужно довести до конца.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:2.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:2.original: In which case, here we go! These are the S Rank exam conditions!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:2.translation: В таком случае — поехали! Вот условия экзамена на ранг S!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:3.original: What? We can just make whatever we want?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:3.translation: Что? Мы можем сделать что угодно?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:4.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:4.original: Yes, that's right. You can bring me anything, so just long as it's the best possible quality.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:4.translation: Да, именно. Принесите мне что угодно — лишь бы качество было наивысшим.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:5.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:5.original: I want to see the culmination of everything you can do. All your skill and heart poured into a single item.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:5.translation: Хочу увидеть вершину всего, на что вы способны. Всё мастерство и всё сердце — в одном предмете.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:6.original: Understood! That's what we'll bring you!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:6.translation: Поняли! Вот что мы вам принесём!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:7.original: We'll apply everything we've learned so far to achieve this!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:7.translation: Мы применим всё, чему научились до сих пор!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:8.speaker: Mireille
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:8.original: Hehe, good! This is your final challenge, twins. Do your very best.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_100.ebm:8.translation: Хе-хе, хорошо! Это ваше последнее испытание, близнецы. Выкладывайтесь на полную.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:0.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:0.original: Hey girls! Want to have some fun? Hmm, maybe not?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:0.translation: Эй, девочки! Хотите повеселиться? Хм… может, не сейчас?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:1.original: Ah. Hi, Firis. No, we are happy to see you!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:1.translation: Ах. Привет, Фирис. Нет, мы рады тебя видеть!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:2.original: Of course we are. We're also just really busy at the moment.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:2.translation: Конечно. Просто мы сейчас очень заняты.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:3.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:3.original: That's a good thing, but what brought this on?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:3.translation: Это хорошо, но что вас так подстегнуло?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:4.original: We want to become the greatest atelier in the kingdom, after all...
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:4.translation: Мы ведь хотим стать величайшим ателье королевства...

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:5.original: And after that we're aiming to become alchemists who can help everyone!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:5.translation: А потом — алхимиками, которые помогут каждому!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:6.original: So we need to hone our alchemy as much as we can.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:6.translation: Поэтому нам нужно максимально отточить алхимию.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:7.original: We want mom to see us make it, before she vanishes completely...
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:7.translation: Мы хотим, чтобы мама увидела, как мы этого добились, пока она совсем не исчезла...

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:9.original: S-Sorry! You took the time to come and visit, and we're just dragging you down!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:9.translation: П-прости! Ты нашла время зайти, а мы тебя только тянем вниз!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:10.original: Hey, I know! A game! Let's play a game, Firis! Yes?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:10.translation: Эй, знаю! Игра! Давай поиграем, Фирис! Да?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:11.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:11.original: Sure thing! I'm not going to lose to you, either!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:11.translation: Конечно! Я тебе тоже не проиграю!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:12.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:12.original: Ah! Sorry for just barging in, but that was fun!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:12.translation: Ах! Простите, что вот так ворвалась — но это было весело!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:13.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:13.original: Not at all. We enjoyed it too. Come again any time!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:13.translation: Вовсе нет. Нам тоже понравилось. Заходи в любое время!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:14.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:14.original: Thanks! One thing, though. Don't push yourselves too hard!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:15.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:15.original: I don't think we're pushing ourselves too hard. Maybe that's what it looks like from the outside.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:15.translation: Не думаю, что мы перегибаем. Может, со стороны так выглядит.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:16.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:16.original: Yeah. I just really don't want to lose Mom again.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:16.translation: Ага. Я просто очень не хочу снова потерять маму.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:17.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:17.original: Phew. I think we should take a break tonight, though.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:17.translation: Уф. Хотя сегодня вечером, пожалуй, стоит сделать перерыв.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:18.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_110.ebm:18.original: Not a bad idea. Goodnight, Sue.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:0.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:0.original: That's my thinking on it. This is what I want to make.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:0.translation: Вот что я думаю. Вот что я хочу сделать.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:1.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:1.original: There isn't much time left, though, so I'd like to ask for your help. What do you think?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:1.translation: Времени осталось мало, так что я хотела бы попросить вашей помощи. Как думаете?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:2.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:2.original: You can count me in. I'm happy to try and help them.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:2.translation: Можете на меня рассчитывать. Я с радостью попробую им помочь.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:3.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:3.original: Thanks! Let's start by thinking of some recipes.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:5.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:5.original: Ah! I'll see you later, Ilmeria, anyway!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:5.translation: Ах! В любом случае, увидимся позже, Ильмерия!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:6.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:6.original: She said "ah", didn't she. Sophie just said "ah". That's suspicious!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:6.translation: Она сказала «ах», правда? Софи только что сказала «ах». Подозрительно!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:7.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:7.original: Hey, don't read too much into anything. Sophie's an adult, she has her own stuff to deal with.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:7.translation: Эй, не накручивайте. Софи взрослая — у неё свои дела.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:8.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:8.original: Is that all it is? I guess we'll let it slide, for now.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_120.ebm:8.translation: И это всё? Ладно, пока оставим.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:0.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:0.original: Miss Sophie! About our little plan, look at this.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:0.translation: Мисс Софи! Насчёт нашего маленького плана — глянь.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:1.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:1.original: Hmm, it looks like it's going well. How about you, Plachta?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:1.translation: Хм, похоже, всё идёт хорошо. А у тебя, Плахта?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:2.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:2.original: I'm making good progress too. Being able to synthesize for myself helps too.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:2.translation: У меня тоже хороший прогресс. То, что я могу сама синтезировать, тоже помогает.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:6.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:6.original: Hello! Go on, what were you talking about?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:6.translation: Привет! Ну же, о чём вы говорили?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:7.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:7.original: Ah, at this rate we'll be able to make a giant Puni Jelly!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:7.translation: Ах, такими темпами мы сможем сделать гигантское желе Пуни!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:8.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:8.original: T-That's right! Puni Jelly bigger than this atelier! I can hardly wait!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:8.translation: Т-точно! Желе Пуни больше этого ателье! Еле жду!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:9.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:9.original: Ahem. They are joking. We're making plans to expand this atelier.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:9.translation: Кхм. Они шутят. Мы планируем расширить это ателье.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:10.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:10.original: Having gathering materials from so many places, we're running out of space!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:10.translation: Набрали материалов со стольких мест — места уже не хватает!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:11.original: That's all? I thought for sure you were planning something more than that. Something crafty!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:11.translation: И всё? Я уж думала, вы задумали что-то похитрее!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:12.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:12.original: C-Crafty? Sue, you're getting carried away again.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:14.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:14.original: No problem. If you want to pay me back, you can help sort the bookshelves. All of them. All right?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_130.ebm:14.translation: Без проблем. Хотите отплатить — помогите разобрать книжные полки. Все. Понятно?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:0.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:0.original: You're going to help, of course? I mean, you're going to help.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:0.translation: Ты ведь поможешь, правда? То есть — ты поможешь.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:1.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:1.original: Hah. I can't beat you, I know. I'll help! I want to protect their future, too, you know.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:1.translation: Ха. Тебя не переспорить, знаю. Помогу! Я тоже хочу защитить их будущее.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:2.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:2.original: Hahaha, excellent. Thanks for this, Alt.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:3.original: Ooh! This sounds good. What are you two planning now? Thanks for what?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:3.translation: Оо! Звучит занятно. Что вы двое замышляете? Спасибо — за что?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:4.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:4.original: Hello, girls. Have you ever heard of knocking?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:4.translation: Здравствуйте, девочки. Вы когда-нибудь слышали о стуке в дверь?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:5.original: Ah, sorry. The door was ajar, so.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:5.translation: Ах, прости. Дверь была приоткрыта, так что...

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:6.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:6.original: Then someone should have closed it properly. I should have noticed that, too, though.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:6.translation: Тогда кому-то следовало закрыть её как следует. Хотя я тоже должен был заметить.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:8.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:8.original: Enough about doors! What's going on between you two?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:8.translation: Хватит про двери! Что у вас двоих происходит?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:10.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:10.original: You look very close and friendly all of a sudden!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:10.translation: Вы вдруг выглядите такими близкими и дружными!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:11.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:11.original: Ooh, this is a like a romance comic! I sense a mature and thrilling development ahead!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:11.translation: Оо, прямо как в любовном комиксе! Чувствую зрелый и захватывающий сюжет!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:12.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:12.original: Now. While these silly sisters are off in their own little world. Run for it!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:12.translation: А теперь. Пока эти глупые сестрёнки витают в облаках — бежим!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:14.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:14.original: Ah! The love between two a few years apart. It's so moving! I'm so moved!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:14.translation: Ах! Любовь с разницей в несколько лет. Так трогательно! Я растрогана!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:15.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:15.original: Is it wrong? No! But is it right? The beauty of love, to overcome all barriers between them!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:15.translation: Это неправильно? Нет! Но правильно ли? Красота любви, что преодолевает все преграды!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:16.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:16.original: Man, how am I going to snap them out of this? You owe me big time for this one, Sophie!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_140.ebm:16.translation: Господи, как их от этого отвлечь? Ты мне за это крепко должна, Софи!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:0.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:0.original: So I've been thinking... Sophie is definitely planning something, isn't she?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:0.translation: Я тут думала… Софи определённо что-то замышляет, правда?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:1.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:1.original: Yes, definitely. I don't think it's anything bad, but I'd still like to know what it is!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:1.translation: Да, определённо. Не думаю, что это плохое, но всё равно хочется знать, что именно!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:2.original: Me too. I guess we just have to ask her...
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:2.translation: И я. Пожалуй, просто спросим её...

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:3.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:3.original: Did you hear all that, Miss Sophie! They are super suspicious of you!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:3.translation: Вы всё слышали, мисс Софи! Они вас ужасно подозревают!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:4.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:4.original: Hahaha, sorry girls. I'm not very good at this kind of thing.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:4.translation: Ха-ха-ха, простите, девочки. Я не очень умею в такие штуки.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:5.original: Sophie! Firis! What are you doing here?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:5.translation: Софи! Фирис! Что вы здесь делаете?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:6.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:6.original: Well, just like you said, we've been planning something...
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:6.translation: Ну, как вы и сказали — мы кое-что планировали...

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:7.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:7.original: That's right. Now we've made some progress, we've come to see you about it.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:7.translation: Верно. Теперь, когда есть прогресс, мы пришли поговорить с вами об этом.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:8.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:8.original: Before that, though, we want to ask your feelings. To make sure we're doing the right thing.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:8.translation: Но сначала хотим спросить, что вы чувствуете. Чтобы убедиться, что поступаем правильно.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:9.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:9.original: Tell me, girls. You don't want to say goodbye to Honnete, do you?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:9.translation: Скажите, девочки. Вы ведь не хотите прощаться с Оннет?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:10.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:10.original: Tell us what you are really feeling. That's what we need to know.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:10.translation: Расскажите, что вы на самом деле чувствуете. Это нам и нужно знать.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:12.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:12.original: Of course we don't. Of course not! She's our mom. What else could we be, but sad?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:12.translation: Конечно, не хотим! Конечно! Она наша мама. Как нам ещё быть, кроме как грустить?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:13.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:13.original: I know. Sorry for even asking.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:14.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:14.original: I was alone, until I met Plachta. I know what it's like to lose your family.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:14.translation: Я была одна, пока не встретила Плахту. Я знаю, каково терять семью.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:15.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:15.original: You've just been reunited with her, too. You don't want to lose her again now!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:15.translation: Вы только воссоединились с ней. Нельзя снова её потерять!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:17.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:17.original: There's nothing we can do, though. She's vanishing, and that's just the way it is.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:17.translation: Но мы ничего не можем сделать. Она исчезает — вот как есть.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:18.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:18.original: So we wanted to show her the best we can do, before that happens. Our best possible alchemy.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:18.translation: Поэтому мы хотели показать ей лучшее, на что способны, пока не поздно. Нашу лучшую алхимию.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:19.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:19.original: That's very impressive, girls. You're working hard, positively, toward something.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:19.translation: Это очень впечатляет, девочки. Вы усердно и по-доброму идёте к цели.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:20.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:20.original: In which case, feel like working just a little bit harder?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:20.translation: А тогда — не хотите поработать ещё чуть усерднее?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:22.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:22.original: Have you ever felt that alchemy just seems like a dream?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:22.translation: Вам когда-нибудь казалось, что алхимия — словно мечта?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:23.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:23.original: I thought I could never leave my home, but here I am, traveling the world thanks to alchemy.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:23.translation: Я думала, никогда не смогу покинуть дом — а вот я путешествую по миру благодаря алхимии.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:24.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:24.original: Alchemy is the power of dreams, making the impossible possible. That's what I believe.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:24.translation: Алхимия — сила мечты, делающая невозможное возможным. Вот во что я верю.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:25.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:25.original: Alchemy has the power to make everyone happy, too. It can make everyone in the world happy!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:25.translation: Алхимия способна сделать счастливыми и всех. Всех в мире!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:26.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:26.original: So we want to use it make you happy. That's why we made this.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:26.translation: Поэтому мы хотим использовать её, чтобы сделать счастливыми вас. Вот зачем мы сделали это.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:27.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:27.original: It's a recipe? For the "Pastels of Unity"?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:28.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:28.original: Yes. This is an item should be able to secure Honnete in this world.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:28.translation: Да. Этот предмет должен закрепить Оннет в этом мире.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:29.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:29.original: If you use those pastels, she won't have to disappear.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:29.translation: Если воспользуетесь этой пастелью — ей не придётся исчезать.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:30.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:30.original: Making them will be incredibly hard, but still. Do you want to give it a try?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:30.translation: Сделать её будет невероятно сложно, но всё же. Хотите попробовать?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:34.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:34.original: Yes! "Don't give up before you even try!" Why had we just given up?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:34.translation: Да! «Не сдавайся, даже не попробовав!» Почему мы просто сдались?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:35.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:35.original: We've seen alchemy overcome so much already, first hand!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:35.translation: Мы своими глазами видели, как алхимия преодолевала столько всего!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:36.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:36.original: Sophie! Firis! Please, let us make this item!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:36.translation: Софи! Фирис! Пожалуйста, позвольте нам сделать этот предмет!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:37.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:37.original: No matter how hard it may be, we will do it!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:37.translation: Как бы тяжело ни было — мы сделаем!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:38.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:38.original: Hehe. I know you so well now. I knew that's what you'd say.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:38.translation: Хе-хе. Теперь я вас так хорошо знаю. Я знала, что вы так скажете.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:39.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:39.original: Right then! Let the mission "Stop Honnete from Vanishing" start at once!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:39.translation: Тогда вперёд! Миссия «Не дать Оннет исчезнуть» начинается немедленно!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:43.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:43.original: First, you need all the materials. And those materials have to be made, too! This is tough!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:43.translation: Сначала вам нужны все материалы. И эти материалы тоже нужно изготовить! Это тяжело!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:44.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:44.original: We have Plachta, Alt and Ilmeria working on recipes for the items that will make the materials.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:44.translation: Плахта, Альт и Ильмерия работают над рецептами предметов, из которых получатся материалы.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:45.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:45.original: Miss Sophie and I are working on the main recipe, but we need a little more time.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:45.translation: Мы с мисс Софи работаем над основным рецептом, но нужно ещё немного времени.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:46.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:46.original: Will you go and see them first, please? We'll finish this while you do that!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:46.translation: Сходите сначала к ним, пожалуйста? А мы тем временем закончим!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:47.speaker: Sophie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:47.original: This mission will be a success! We'll see you soon!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:47.translation: Эта миссия будет успешной! Скоро увидимся!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:48.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:48.original: Wow. Those two are something else. They knew exactly how we were feeling.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:48.translation: Ого. Эти двое — нечто. Они точно знали, что мы чувствуем.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:49.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:49.original: Yeah. They even made us this recipe. Do you think we can be like them, one day?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:49.translation: Ага. Они даже сделали нам этот рецепт. Как думаешь, сможем ли мы когда-нибудь стать такими же?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:50.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:50.original: I don't know, but we can try! Which means, right now...
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:50.translation: Не знаю, но мы можем стараться! А значит, прямо сейчас...

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:51.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:51.original: We need to make the Pastels of Unity! Come on then, let's do this!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_150.ebm:51.translation: Нам нужно сделать Пастель единства! Давай же!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:0.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:0.original: Plachta! We're here about the Pastels of Unity!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:0.translation: Плахта! Мы здесь насчёт Пастели единства!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:1.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:1.original: Ah, I've been waiting for you. The recipe you need is already finished.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:1.translation: Ах, я вас ждала. Нужный рецепт уже готов.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:2.original: That's perfect, Plachta! You work as fast as always... and wow, look how neatly it's written!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:2.translation: Прекрасно, Плахта! Ты как всегда быстра… и ого, как аккуратно написано!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:3.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:3.original: Of course it is. You are trying to create something beyond normal comprehension.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:3.translation: Разумеется. Вы пытаетесь создать нечто за пределами обычного понимания.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:4.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:4.original: A divine realm, into which no normal alchemist would dare to tread.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:4.translation: Божественная сфера, куда обычный алхимик и ступить не осмелится.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:5.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:5.original: But I'm sure you can do this. You can make the impossible.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:5.translation: Но я уверена — у вас получится. Вы можете сделать невозможное.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:6.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:6.original: I agree, actually. I really think we can, too.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:6.translation: Я, кстати, согласна. Я и правда думаю, что мы сможем.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:7.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:7.original: Yes. Alchemy exists to make people happy. My feelings have not changed in 500 years.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:7.translation: Да. Алхимия существует, чтобы делать людей счастливыми. Мои чувства не изменились за пятьсот лет.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:8.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:8.original: This recipe has been created out of gratitude and best wishes for you both.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:8.translation: Этот рецепт создан из благодарности и самых добрых пожеланий вам обеим.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:9.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:9.original: I believe it is the key to your happiness. Here, take it.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:9.translation: Я верю — это ключ к вашему счастью. Вот, возьмите.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:10.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:10.original: Thank you. Thank you for all of that, Plachta.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:10.translation: Спасибо. Спасибо тебе за всё это, Плахта.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:11.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:11.original: Once you complete it, will you bring it to show me? I'm counting on you both.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_160.ebm:11.translation: Когда закончите — принесёте показать? Я рассчитываю на вас обеих.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:0.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:0.original: Plachta! We've made the item from your recipe!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:0.translation: Плахта! Мы сделали предмет по твоему рецепту!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:1.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:1.original: You have? Then let me take a look. Hmm.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:2.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:2.original: I see no problems with this. You really have improved so much, girls.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:2.translation: Проблем не вижу. Вы и правда так сильно выросли, девочки.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:3.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:3.original: Hahaha! I guess we've really made it, when Plachta praises us like that!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:3.translation: Ха-ха-ха! Кажется, мы и правда чего-то добились, раз Плахта так хвалит!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:4.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:4.original: I know! I'm not sure we can get any higher than this!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:4.translation: Знаю! Не уверена, что можно подняться ещё выше!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:5.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:5.original: Hmm. If you keep being this weird I will take back my praise.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:5.translation: Хм. Если продолжите так чудить — заберу свою похвалу назад.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:6.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:6.original: Now, off you go. You still have something left to do, correct?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:6.translation: А теперь идите. У вас ещё есть дела, верно?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:7.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:7.original: Ah, of course! Sorry, we got a bit too carried away!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:7.translation: Ах, конечно! Простите, мы немного увлеклись!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:8.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:8.original: Hehe. You're right about one thing. After being praised by me, there's nothing you can't do.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:8.translation: Хе-хе. В одном вы правы. После моей похвалы для вас нет ничего невозможного.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:9.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:9.original: Keep up the good work. I'm always in your corner, Lydie, Suelle.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:9.translation: Продолжайте в том же духе. Я всегда на вашей стороне, Лидия, Сюэль.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:10.speaker: Plachta
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:10.original: Hehe. They remind me so much of Sophie and Firis. I'm sure they can do this.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_170.ebm:10.translation: Хе-хе. Они так напоминают мне Софи и Фирис. Уверена — они справятся.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:0.original: Ilmeria. We're here about the Pastels of Unity.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:0.translation: Ильмерия. Мы здесь насчёт Пастели единства.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:3.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:3.original: If you had a problem, why didn't you come to see me?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:3.translation: Если у вас была проблема — почему не пришли ко мне?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:4.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:4.original: I'm your mentor! I don't think I have any recipes to share with students who won't come to see me.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:4.translation: Я ваша наставница! Не думаю, что у меня найдутся рецепты для учениц, которые ко мне не ходят.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:5.original: W-What?! We're sorry! We'd pretty much given up, you see...
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:5.translation: Ч-что?! Простите! Мы ведь почти сдались...

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:6.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:6.original: Hehe, I'm just joking. Although I do wish you had come to see me.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:6.translation: Хе-хе, я шучу. Хотя мне и правда хотелось бы, чтобы вы пришли.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:7.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:7.original: I know you were struggling with it, though, and it was hard for you to talk about.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:7.translation: Я знаю — вам было тяжело, и говорить об этом было трудно.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:8.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:8.original: So I'm not going to hold it against you. You just be sure to make this item.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:8.translation: Так что зла держать не буду. Просто обязательно сделайте этот предмет.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:9.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:9.original: This is your recipe for us. Gulp! It looks pretty tough!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:9.translation: Это твой рецепт для нас. *сглатывает* Выглядит довольно жёстко!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:10.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:10.original: Oh yes, it's very difficult! What do you think? Shall I make it for you?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:10.translation: О да, очень сложно! Как думаете? Может, я сделаю за вас?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:11.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:11.original: No, let us do it. It's meaningless if this isn't us.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:11.translation: Нет, пусть сделаем мы. Иначе в этом не будет смысла.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:12.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:12.original: Heheh, that's the way. That's my students.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:12.translation: Хе-хе, вот так. Это мои ученицы.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:13.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:13.original: Off you go, then, go get started. Once you're done come and show it to me.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:13.translation: Тогда идите, начинайте. Как закончите — приходите показать.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:14.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:14.original: I'll check to make sure you got it right. Don't hold anything back for this one!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_180.ebm:14.translation: Я проверю, что всё сделано верно. На этот раз — без всяких поблажек!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:0.original: Teach, we've done it. Please, take a look!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:1.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:1.original: Good work. Yes, this looks perfect. You've really upped your game, girls!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:1.translation: Отличная работа. Да, выглядит идеально. Вы и правда выросли, девочки!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:2.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:2.original: A recipe made by a super alchemist, completed by her super students!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:3.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:3.original: This is one super item. So go ahead and keep this up!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:3.translation: Вот это суперпредмет. Так что продолжайте в том же духе!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:4.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:4.original: I'm not going to allow my students to end up sad! I won't allow you to end up that way!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:4.translation: Я не позволю своим ученицам остаться с грустью! Не позволю вам закончить так!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:5.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:5.original: Don't worry. We're going to be happy, you'll see!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:5.translation: Не волнуйся. Мы будем счастливы — вот увидишь!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:6.original: Ilmeria, thank you! I'll see you again soon!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:7.speaker: Ilmeria
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:7.original: You've got this. I'm so proud of you, my students!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_190.ebm:7.translation: У вас получится. Я так вами горжусь, мои ученицы!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:1.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:1.original: Hah, perfect timing. This is what you're here for, right?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:1.translation: Ха, как раз вовремя. Вы за этим и пришли, да?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:2.translation: Ува! У тебя ужасный почерк, Альт!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:3.original: Yeah... But I think we can handle it. Barely, but I can make it out.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:3.translation: Ага… Но думаю, справимся. Еле-еле, но разобрать можно.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:4.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:4.original: Sorry about that. My handwriting has always been like that, for the longest time.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:4.translation: Простите. Мой почерк всегда был таким — сколько себя помню.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:5.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:5.original: Ahem. Anyway, we've been through a lot, but I'm grateful to you.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:5.translation: Кхм. В любом случае, мы через многое прошли — и я вам благодарен.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:6.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:6.original: I've managed to part ways with my past self and restore bonds of friendship, thanks to you.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:6.translation: Благодаря вам я сумел расстаться с прежним собой и восстановить узы дружбы.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:7.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:7.original: This recipe is packed with all my gratitude to you.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:7.translation: В этом рецепте — вся моя благодарность вам.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:9.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:9.original: You'll face all kinds of challenges in life, like it or not.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:9.translation: В жизни, нравится вам или нет, встретятся самые разные испытания.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:10.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:10.original: But, from personal experience, I can say that none of these challenges are impossible.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:10.translation: Но по личному опыту скажу: ни одно из них не невозможно.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:11.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:11.original: The most important thing is to try. Set your goal and continue forward towards it.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:11.translation: Главное — попробовать. Поставьте цель и идите к ней.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:12.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:12.original: I believe you can do that. You do too, right?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:12.translation: Я верю, что вы сможете. Вы тоже, правда?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:14.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:14.original: Once you've made the item, come and show it to me. I'll check to make sure it's good enough.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:14.translation: Когда сделаете предмет — приходите показать. Я проверю, достаточно ли он хорош.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:15.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:15.original: Now, go. Show me what you can do, one more time.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_200.ebm:15.translation: А теперь идите. Покажите мне ещё раз, на что способны.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:0.original: Alt! Here it is. What do you think?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:1.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:1.original: More than enough. Well done, girls.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:2.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:2.original: It was really hard! Your handwriting is barely better than scribble!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:2.translation: Это было правда тяжело! Твой почерк едва лучше каракуль!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:3.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:3.original: Ahem, I told you to get over that. I've tried to improve it but it just doesn't take.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:3.translation: Кхм, я же просил забыть об этом. Я пытался улучшить — не берётся.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:4.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:4.original: Enough about that, anyway. This will be enough to act as materials for the item in question.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:4.translation: В любом случае, хватит об этом. Этого хватит как материалов для нужного предмета.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:5.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:5.original: Now just carry on toward your goal. That's what you're best at!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:5.translation: Теперь просто идите к своей цели. В этом вы лучше всего!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:7.original: Hehe, thanks! We'll show you just how we will reach our goal!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:7.translation: Хе-хе, спасибо! Мы покажем тебе, как достигнем цели!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:9.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:9.original: I guess I've mellowed a bit in my old age. I never would have expected this from myself not too long ago.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:9.translation: Похоже, к старости я немного смягчился. Ещё недавно я бы от себя такого не ждал.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:10.speaker: Alt
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:10.original: But I guess this isn't so bad. Right, Plachta?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_210.ebm:10.translation: Но, пожалуй, это не так уж плохо. Правда, Плахта?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:0.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:0.original: Hmm, interesting. So what if this goes here...
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:0.translation: Хм, интересно. А если вот это сюда...

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:1.speaker: Roger
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:1.original: Ah! I never would have thought of that. Now this is getting me fired up!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:1.translation: Ах! Я бы никогда об этом не подумал. Теперь это меня заводит!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:2.original: What are you doing, Dad? It looks like the two of you are having quite a lot of fun.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:2.translation: Что ты делаешь, пап? Похоже, вам двоим очень весело.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:3.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:3.original: Hey, you two. I was just thinking up a recipe with Roger.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:3.translation: Эй, вы двое. Я как раз придумывала рецепт с Роджером.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:4.speaker: Roger
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:4.original: I heard the rumors, but the real deal is even more impressive. This was a lot of fun, Firis.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:4.translation: Я слышал слухи, но реальность ещё впечатляюще. Это было очень весело, Фирис.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:5.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:5.original: Not at all, I enjoyed it too! All your ideas have given me a lot to work with.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:5.translation: Вовсе нет — мне тоже понравилось! Все твои идеи дали мне столько материала для работы.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:6.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:6.original: Is this the budding of a friendship I see?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:7.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:7.original: So, Firis. I take it you came to our atelier to see us?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:7.translation: Итак, Фирис. Ты пришла в наше ателье к нам?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:8.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:8.original: Ah, that's right. I came to give you both this.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:8.translation: Ах, точно. Я пришла отдать вам вот это.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:9.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:9.original: The recipe for your material for the Pastels of Unity?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:9.translation: Рецепт твоего материала для Пастели единства?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:10.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:10.original: Not quite. Mine isn't a material, but a cauldron.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:10.translation: Не совсем. У меня не материал, а котёл.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:11.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:11.original: What? A cauldron? Like an alchemy cauldron?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:12.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:12.original: Yep. There are all kinds of alchemy cauldrons, and you need a good one for difficult alchemy.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:12.translation: Ага. Алхимических котлов много разных, а для сложной алхимии нужен хороший.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:13.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:13.original: So I'm giving you this recipe for a new cauldron. Do you think you can make it?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:13.translation: Так что я даю вам рецепт нового котла. Думаете, сможете сделать?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:14.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:14.original: We'll give it a try. Can you use an alchemy cauldron to make an alchemy cauldron, though?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:14.translation: Попробуем. Но можно ли алхимическим котлом сделать алхимический котёл?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:15.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:15.original: Of course you can! What's wrong with that?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:15.translation: Конечно можно! Что в этом плохого?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:16.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:16.original: It feels completely wrong to me, but trying to apply logic to alchemy is a dark path!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:16.translation: Мне кажется, это совершенно неправильно… но применять логику к алхимии — тёмный путь!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:17.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:17.original: Very well! We'll give it a try!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:18.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:18.original: That's the way. Alchemy makes dreams come true. Make a wish, and it will happen for you!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:18.translation: Вот так. Алхимия воплощает мечты. Загадайте желание — и оно сбудется!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:19.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:19.original: Don't give up until the end, girls! You can do it!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_220.ebm:19.translation: Не сдавайтесь до конца, девочки! У вас получится!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:0.original: Hahaha! We made an alchemy cauldron using an alchemy cauldron!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:0.translation: Ха-ха-ха! Мы сделали алхимический котёл с помощью алхимического котла!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:1.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:1.original: I didn't notice as we worked, but this doesn't fit inside the original cauldron, does it?
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:1.translation: Пока работали — не заметила, но ведь он не влезает в исходный котёл?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:2.original: You're right. So how did we... no, like I said. Let's not start down that dark path...
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:2.translation: Ты права. Так как же мы… нет, как я и сказала. Не пойдём по этому тёмному пути...

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:3.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:3.original: Hahaha, well, we did it so I guess that's all that matters! Let's go and let Firis know!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:3.translation: Ха-ха-ха, ну, мы сделали — и это главное! Пойдём скажем Фирис!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:4.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:4.original: Good idea. Sophie might have finished her recipe too.
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:4.translation: Хорошая идея. Софи, может, тоже закончила свой рецепт.

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:5.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:5.original: Still. That cauldron definitely doesn't fit inside the cauldron that made it...
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:5.translation: И всё же. Этот котёл определённо не влезает в тот, в котором его сделали...

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:6.speaker: Sue
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:6.original: Hey, stop that! You can't let that get in your head! Come on, Lydie!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_230.ebm:6.translation: Эй, хватит! Нельзя об этом думать! Давай, Лиди!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_240.ebm:0.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_240.ebm:0.original: Firis. We've made the alchemy cauldron!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_240.ebm:1.speaker: Firis
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_240.ebm:1.original: Really? Great work. Did it all work out?

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_240.ebm:2.speaker: Lydie
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_240.ebm:2.original: We gave it a try, and you know what? It worked!
ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_240.ebm:2.translation: Мы попробовали — и знаешь что? Сработало!

ebm:mm12/event_message_mm12_240.ebm:3.speaker: Firis
